metadata.title: Data Deletion — PRESTIGO Premium Chauffeur Prague
metadata.description: How to request deletion of your personal data from PRESTIGO. GDPR data erasure request instructions.

requestReceived.label: Request Received
requestReceived.paragraph1: Your data deletion request has been received and will be processed within 30 days. Your confirmation code:
requestReceived.paragraph2Prefix: Keep this code for your records. If you have questions, email

section1.title: What data PRESTIGO holds
section1.text: If you booked a transfer or submitted an enquiry, we hold your name, email address, phone number, and booking details. We also process anonymised website analytics data via Google Analytics and Meta Pixel. We do not store your Facebook user ID — the Meta Pixel only sends hashed behavioural data for ad measurement purposes.

section2.title: How to request deletion
section2.paragraph1Suffix: with the subject line “Data Deletion Request”. Include the email address associated with your booking or enquiry.
section2.paragraph2: We will confirm receipt within 3 business days and complete the deletion within 30 days, unless we are required by law to retain certain records (e.g. invoices for tax purposes — retained for 5 years as required by Czech law).

section3.title: Deletion via Facebook
section3.paragraph1Prefix: If you used Facebook Login or interacted with PRESTIGO through Facebook and wish to remove access, you can do so via
section3.paragraph1Suffix: . This removes our app’s access to your Facebook account. For deletion of any booking data we may hold, please also email us as described above.
